inputs.goal: Add a capitalize helper to src/text.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `capitalize(s: string): string` in src/text.ts: upper-case the first character and leave the rest of the string unchanged. The empty string stays empty. Add tests.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Add `capitalize` to src/text.ts: upper-case the first character, keep the rest as is, handle the empty string.
2. Add tests in src/text.test.ts.
inputs.implementation_summary: Added `capitalize` to src/text.ts. It takes the first character by code point (array destructuring), so a character outside the BMP is never split, upper-cases it and appends the rest unchanged; the empty string stays empty. Tests cover ordinary words, mixed case, the empty string, a non-letter start and non-ASCII input. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
